import { FileOptimizerSDK } from './src/sdk/FileOptimizerSDK.js'; const logBox = document.getElementById('logBox'); const statusBadge = document.getElementById('statusBadge'); function log(msg) { logBox.innerHTML += `
[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ${msg}`; logBox.scrollTop = logBox.scrollHeight; } // Attach SDK auto-compress to demo input FileOptimizerSDK.attachToInput('#demoInput', { maxSizeBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024, // Target < 2 MB onStart: (files) => { statusBadge.className = 'status-badge compressing'; statusBadge.textContent = 'Mengompresi otomatis...'; log(`File dipilih: ${files[0].name} (${(files[0].size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB)`); }, onSuccess: (files) => { const file = files[0]; const meta = file.optimizerMeta || {}; statusBadge.className = 'status-badge done'; statusBadge.textContent = 'Selesai (< 2MB)'; log(`Status: File berhasil dikompresi.`); log(`Ukuran Awal: ${(meta.originalSize / (1024*1024)).toFixed(2)} MB → Ukuran Akhir: ${(file.size / (1024*1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`); log(`Resolusi: ${meta.width} × ${meta.height} px (Resolusi 100% Terjaga)`); log(`File siap dikirim ke backend / server.`); }, onError: (err) => { statusBadge.className = 'status-badge waiting'; statusBadge.textContent = 'Gagal'; log(`Error: ${err.message}`); } });
